kernel_change.diagnosis: _knowledge/evidence/fixed-kernel-residual-mechanisms-2026-10-03.md (the forward isospin probe, the isospin completion by sector, the isovector exchange class)
kernel_change.isospin_completion: baryonic Q = -1, 0, +2; strange baryonic Q = +-1; strange mesonic K- and K+ like (decay daughters)
kernel_change.delta_lines: the I = 3/2 root families at Q = +1 and 0 (the isovector exchange's Delta-like lines)
kernel_change.isovector_exchange: I = 1 exchange, I3 transfer t = -1, 0, +1 with the Clebsch-Gordan line states (P(t) = 1/3, equal reduced couplings), drawn per SD, DD and ND event; the transfer slope and the mass laws shared with the vacuum exchange
